name: Get Pests Data
Zone Atomation Tool
Get Plant Diseases Data
Get BOM Stock Balances
Get Greenhouse Reentry Status
script:
greenhouse_name = frappe.form_dict.get('greenhouse')
input_date = frappe.form_dict.get('date')

if not greenhouse_name or not input_date:
    frappe.response['http_status_code'] = 400
    frappe.response['message'] = "Missing 'greenhouse' and/or 'date' parameter."
    exit()

filters = [
    ["custom_greenhouse", "=", greenhouse_name],
    ["docstatus", "=", 1],
    ["custom_scheduled_application_time", ">=", input_date]
]

work_orders = frappe.get_list(
    doctype="Work Order",
    filters=filters,
    fields=[
        "name", 
        "custom_scheduled_application_time",
        "custom_reentry_time"
    ],
    order_by="custom_scheduled_application_time asc"
)

frappe.response['data'] = work_orders

name: Fetch Scheduled Applications
script:
try:
    start_date = frappe.form_dict.get('start_date')

    filters = {
        "docstatus": 1,
        "custom_type": "Application Floor Plan"
    }

    if start_date:
        filters["custom_scheduled_application_time"] = [">=", start_date]

    work_orders = frappe.get_all(
        "Work Order",
        filters=filters,
        fields=[
            "name",
            "status",
            "custom_type",
            "custom_greenhouse",
            "custom_scope",
            "custom_scope_details",
            "custom_area",
            "custom_water_volume",
            "custom_water_ph",
            "custom_water_hardness",
            "custom_variety",
            "custom_spray_type",
            "custom_kit",
            "custom_targets",
            "custom_spray_team",
            "custom_reentry_time",
            "custom_scheduled_application_time",
            "wip_warehouse"
        ]
    )

    if work_orders:
        wo_names = [wo.get('name') for wo in work_orders]
        
        required_items_data = frappe.get_all(
            "Work Order Item",
            filters={
                "parent": ("in", wo_names)
            },
            fields=["parent", "item_code", "item_name", "required_qty", "stock_uom"],
            order_by="idx asc"
        )

        items_by_wo = {}
        for item in required_items_data:
            parent_name = item.pop('parent')
            if parent_name not in items_by_wo:
                items_by_wo[parent_name] = []
            items_by_wo[parent_name].append(item)

        for wo in work_orders:
            wo['required_items'] = items_by_wo.get(wo['name'], [])

    frappe.response.data = work_orders

except Exception as e:
    frappe.response.status = 500
    frappe.response.message = "An error occurred while fetching Work Orders."

name: Delete Duplicate Scouting Entries
script:
# Delete duplicate Scouting Entry records. # # A duplicate = two or more entries with the same: # scouts_name, greenhouse, date_of_capture, time_of_capture (to the second), zone # # The EARLIEST record (lowest SCE name) is kept; all others are deleted # along with their child table rows and linked Scouting Entry Metadata. # # HOW TO RUN FROM THE DESK # ------------------------ # 1. Open this Server Script in the Frappe desk. # 2. Leave EXECUTE = False and click Execute -> review the dry-run summary. # 3. Change EXECUTE = True and click Execute again to commit. EXECUTE = False # Change to True to commit deletes YEAR = 2026 # Restrict to this year (None = all years) CHUNK = 200 # Rows per DELETE batch _lines = [] if YEAR: _dup_groups = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT scouts_name, greenhouse, date_of_capture, time_of_capture, zone, COUNT(*) as total, MIN(name) as keep_name FROM `tabScouting Entry` WHERE YEAR(date_of_capture) = %s GROUP BY scouts_name, greenhouse, date_of_capture, time_of_capture, zone HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total DESC """, [YEAR], as_dict=True) else: _dup_groups = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT scouts_name, greenhouse, date_of_capture, time_of_capture, zone, COUNT(*) as total, MIN(name) as keep_name FROM `tabScouting Entry` GROUP BY scouts_name, greenhouse, date_of_capture, time_of_capture, zone HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total DESC """, as_dict=True) _total_sets = len(_dup_groups) _total_delete = 0 for _g in _dup_groups: _total_delete += int(_g.total) - 1 _lines.append("Duplicate groups : %d" % _total_sets) _lines.append("Entries to delete: %d" % _total_delete) _lines.append("") _lines.append("Top 10 groups:") for _g in _dup_groups[:10]: _lines.append(" x%d %s %s %s %s %s" % ( int(_g.total), _g.scouts_name, _g.greenhouse, _g.date_of_capture, _g.time_of_capture, _g.zone, )) if not _dup_groups: _lines.append("Nothing to delete.") elif not EXECUTE: _lines.append("") _lines.append("[DRY RUN] Change EXECUTE = True and run again to delete.") else: _lines.append("") _lines.append("Deleting...") _to_delete = [] for _g in _dup_groups: if YEAR: _dupes = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name FROM `tabScouting Entry` WHERE scouts_name=%s AND greenhouse=%s AND date_of_capture=%s AND time_of_capture=%s AND zone=%s AND YEAR(date_of_capture)=%s AND name!=%s """, [_g.scouts_name, _g.greenhouse, _g.date_of_capture, _g.time_of_capture, _g.zone, YEAR, _g.keep_name], as_dict=True) else: _dupes = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name FROM `tabScouting Entry` WHERE scouts_name=%s AND greenhouse=%s AND date_of_capture=%s AND time_of_capture=%s AND zone=%s AND name!=%s """, [_g.scouts_name, _g.greenhouse, _g.date_of_capture, _g.time_of_capture, _g.zone, _g.keep_name], as_dict=True) for _d in _dupes: _to_delete.append(_d.name) _meta_names = [] _has_se_col = False for _col in frappe.db.sql("DESCRIBE `tabScouting Entry Metadata`", as_dict=True): if _col["Field"] == "scouting_entry": _has_se_col = True break if _has_se_col: _mi = 0 while _mi < len(_to_delete): _chunk = tuple(_to_delete[_mi:_mi + CHUNK]) for _mr in frappe.db.sql( "SELECT name FROM `tabScouting Entry Metadata` WHERE scouting_entry IN %s", (_chunk,), as_dict=True ): _meta_names.append(_mr.name) _mi += CHUNK _CHILDREN = [ "Pests Scouting Entry", "Diseases Scouting Entry", "Predators Scouting Entry", "Weeds Scouting Entry", "Incidents Scouting Entry", "Physiological Disorders Entry", "Trap Scouting Entry", ] _deleted = 0 _errors = 0 _i = 0 while _i < len(_to_delete): _chunk = tuple(_to_delete[_i:_i + CHUNK]) try: for _ct in _CHILDREN: frappe.db.sql("DELETE FROM `tab%s` WHERE parent IN %%s" % _ct, (_chunk,)) frappe.db.sql("DELETE FROM `tabScouting Entry` WHERE name IN %s", (_chunk,)) _deleted += len(_chunk) except Exception as _ex: _errors += 1 _lines.append(" ERROR chunk %d: %s" % (_i, str(_ex))) _i += CHUNK _delm = 0 _j = 0 while _j < len(_meta_names): _chunk = tuple(_meta_names[_j:_j + CHUNK]) try: frappe.db.sql("DELETE FROM `tabScouting Entry Metadata` WHERE name IN %s", (_chunk,)) _delm += len(_chunk) except Exception as _ex: _errors += 1 _j += CHUNK frappe.db.commit() _lines.append("Deleted entries : %d" % _deleted) _lines.append("Deleted metadata : %d" % _delm) _lines.append("Errors : %d" % _errors) _lines.append("DONE") frappe.msgprint("
".join(_lines), title="Duplicate Scouting Entry Cleanup", indicator="green" if EXECUTE else "blue")
